title: Hashtags
hints: A capture group, (...), marks the part you want back. #(\w+) matches a hash sign and captures the word after it.
FindAllStringSubmatch(text, -1) returns every match as a []string: index 0 is the whole match and index 1 is the first group.
Lowercase each tag and keep a map[string]bool of tags you've already added so repeats are skipped while order is kept.
